_comment: How an inflicted sandfall climbs the tiers, dial by dial (design 5.2.2).
Difficulty rather than a verdict: you can roof over sand, and the burial hands you the glass to do it
with. `often` (how often one comes, and how many may stand at once), `long` (how long one lives), `size`
(how wide it grows, up to twenty by twenty) and `depth` (how deep a pass buries). Harmful throughout: it
Leans dry, and a little hot.
